page.title: Training data export (JSONL)
page.intro: Every file strips personal data: the student id is hashed, names, phones and emails are never exported as fields, and phones, emails and links are removed from texts. Each file is deleted automatically when its retention period ends.
page.note: The Ask a Teacher training record is text only (question text + context + final transcript + rating).
